about: Dub's Axiom logging (dubinc/dub 7e010136, apps/web/lib/axiom/server.ts; @axiomhq/logging 0.1.5 over @axiomhq/js 1.3.1, the versions apps/web/package.json resolves) on the World-issued AXIOM_TOKEN and AXIOM_DATASET: its logger flushes a request line and a job refusal, an unbatched ingest reads its status, and the account's dataset list holds the dataset. Readback after resume lists the dataset without writing.
